Name: Maria Anna Waloschek (Note: Some earlier publications may be under the name Maria Saulich)

Profession:
- Freelance Music Higher Education Didactics Specialist & Consultant
- Focus: Music pedagogy, higher education didactics, teaching development

Contact Information:
- Email: mail@maria-anna-waloschek.de

Key Areas of Expertise / Portfolio:
- Communication & Feedback: Developing constructive feedback cultures (e.g., Critical Response Process).
- Cooperative Teaching Formats: Designing and implementing co-teaching and team teaching settings.
- Collegial Exchange & Consulting: Establishing peer consulting and observation formats.
- (Self-)Reflection & Portfolio Work: Using learning and teaching portfolios for development and reflection.
- Teaching Coaching & Didactic Consulting: Individual coaching for educators and strategic consulting for institutions.

Selected Career Highlights (Vita):
- Freelance work designing and conducting workshops, coaching, and consulting.
- Substitute Professor for Music Pedagogy at the University of Münster.
- Coordinated teaching development for the Netzwerk Musikhochschulen (Network Music Universities).
- Developed and led the certificate program "Die Kunst der Lehre" (The Art of Teaching) at HfM Detmold.
- Editor and author of publications on higher education didactics and peer learning.
- Teaching experience at music schools (Bayreuth) and music universities (Münster).
- Active freelance pianist (piano duo, song accompaniment).

Academic Background:
- Diploma in Instrumental Pedagogy (HfM Würzburg)
- Diploma in Artistic Training Piano (HfM Würzburg)
- Professional Diploma in Management (Open University)
- (Previously listed: Master Music Pedagogy, HfMT Köln - currently commented out in source)

Key Publication:
- Waloschek, M. A. & Gruhle, C. (2022). Die Kunst der Lehre. Ein Praxishandbuch für Lehrende an Musikhochschulen. Münster: Waxmann. (Includes chapters on assessment, Critical Response Process, portfolio work, peer observation).

Other Relevant Publications (selection):
- Contributed to "Rahmen zur kriteriengeleiteten Unterrichtsbeobachtung und -beurteilung" (2020) with the Musikdidaktik-Netzwerk der Musikhochschule Münster.
- Articles/Chapters (under Saulich, M.): On improvisation in music universities (2018), ideal teacher qualities (2017), co-teaching/teamteaching (2017), professional development certificate programs (2017).
